findings.title: Hardcoded ngrok auth token in etny_exec_flask.py
findings.description: The ngrok authentication token '2orw7I8y15uYu4ajtlsGwimgAqK_6ke12fFHvBdkWkyYpEyf6' is hardcoded as a default fallback in os.environ.get(). This is a distinct credential from the ESR wallet private key fixed in R1. Although etny_exec_flask.py is not imported by the active code path, the file resides in build/securelock/src/ and will be included in the sealed enclave image. The token is also in git history.
findings.suggestion: Remove the hardcoded fallback so the line reads: auth_token = os.environ.get('ETNY_NGROK_AUTHTOKEN', ''). If the token is needed for development, place it in .env.example with a placeholder. Consider rotating the exposed token on the ngrok dashboard.
